observations: The page number «62» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «oder wie oben bemerkt wurde» continues the explanation of the second proportion from p. 61 (JP2 0093, L34), «also sin HMB : sin PEA = r′ : r,».

L02, L11 and L38: the formulas displayed, centred; the fractions of L02 and L28 built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}; L02 ends with a comma after the last fraction, L11 with a comma after «maxim.». In the denominator of L02 «Dist» has no point, where the numerator has «Dist. r»; see the critical note. L38: the colons of the two divisions set with a word space on either side (31-32 px measured), written ∶ (U+2236); «1p», the p raised and in italics, as in L34.

L11-L15 and L33-L38. Checked: with the greatest latitude of Saturn, 5° (L14), the formula of L11 gives for the argument 130° 24′ a latitudo secunda of 3° 48′ 20″, for 130° 3° 49′ 42″ and for 131° 3° 46′ 17″; the 3° 48′ 27″ of the example, read from Table 31, answers to a greatest latitude of 5° 0′ 9″. 27° 12′ + 103° 12′ = 130° 24′: the true place of Saturn of p. 53 (JP2 0085) and the number of its node in chapter 19 (p. 64, JP2 0096, L38; Latin p. 15, JP2 0047, L08-L09), which the text of chapter 17 adds to the place of the planet («draconis sui numerus loco eiusdem planetae prius examinato coacervabitur», p. 14, JP2 0046, L10-L11), where L12 takes the longitude of the node away. 3° 48½′ = 228½′, and 228½′ : 1¼ = 182.8′, 183′ = 3° 3′. The values of Tables 30 and 31 are to be compared with the tables.

L19: «elheza examinatum (!)», Suter's «(!)» upright: the Latin of chapter 17 (p. 14, JP2 0046, L09) has «elheca … examinatum». L24: «Worten : Die», the capital after the colon as printed. N01: «sin» in italics within the second quotation.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Kh.»; italics: «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Latitudo secunda», «lat. sec.», «argum.», «lat. maxim.», «argumentum», «lat. max.», «lat. secunda», «lat. prima», «Anomalia aequata», «elheza examinatum», «elheza examinata», «r», «r′», «Grade», «Minuten», «Partes», «Minutae,», «Beispiel», «Breite» (L32), «Saturns», «gesuchte Breite.»; «latitudo prima» (L34) and «latitudo secunda» (L37) upright.
The other colons and the semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-13 px measured; «Kh.) ;» in L14, 8 px).
